prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production full-body attack animation keys, a FOUR-CEL 2x2 sprite sheet with REAL transparent alpha. Reference image 1 is the authoritative Utsu game sprite: same adult male identity, same slim ADULT body proportions, head, torso length, long legs, straight steel swords and outfit. Create a muscularly coordinated WEIGHTED dual-sword cut, preserving his lean build, NOT chibi or squat. Whole body visible in every cel with both COMPLETE swords. Fixed side-game camera, opponent SCREEN RIGHT. No enemies.
CRITICAL PROPORTIONS: In the reference the distance from hair crown to chin is about 200px and crown to bottom planted boot about1400px. Thus each ADULT body must measure about 7 HEAD LENGTHS when its bent leg chains are mentally straightened. Keep neck-to-belt 2 heads, belt-to-knees 2 heads and knees-to-soles about2 heads. Head MUST look small relative to the entire body. Do NOT shorten thighs, shins or chest to fit the panel; use smaller whole figures with generous transparent margins. SAME adult limb lengths and same sword length in all four cels. Knees bend modestly for combat, not sitting squat. Do not use exaggerated foreground head foreshortening.
IDENTITY: tired focused gray-eyed masculine face, tousled dark brown hair; navy ragged short cape, ivory split tunic and dark fitted pants/undershirt, brown crossing straps/belt, tarnished brass star brooch, asymmetric silver left pauldron/forearm/knee/boot armor. Two normal rigid one-handed straight steel swords with brass guards and black grips, one per hand, connected to exactly two arms. Same painted anime line quality as reference.
The action is powered by REAR FOOT -> PELVIS -> RIBCAGE -> SHOULDERS -> SWORD, with changing torso orientation. This must be readable from silhouette and belt angle, not just changing hand positions. Arms stay connected to the torso; blade edge cuts an arc, never a straight arm poke.
TOP LEFT, COIL: tall athletic fencing stance, back/side THREE-QUARTER view, hips and chest coiled AWAY from right target. Left/back foot loaded under rear hip, rear knee flexed, front boot heel just planting well toward RIGHT. Weight70% rear leg. Active sword drawn behind shoulder to LEFT, elbow bent, opposing sword low beside rear hip. Spine tall over bent knees, entire thigh/shin lengths clear. Face turns right over lead shoulder.
TOP RIGHT, FIRST CONTACT: strong forward stepping DIAGONAL/HORIZONTAL cut to RIGHT at chest height. Front foot now PLANTED; front knee tracks over ankle, rear leg extends with heel rotating off ground. Pelvis has rotated about60 degrees toward opponent and moved forward over planted front thigh. Chest follows the pelvis; show more of FRONT of tunic/belt than previous cel. Active arm crosses out from shoulder with a slightly bent elbow, steel blade extends toward RIGHT through cut. Other sword trails low-left. This is a CUT powered by hips, not a thrust or reaching hand.
BOTTOM LEFT, FIRST FOLLOW-THROUGH / RETURN WINDUP: weight firmly over front leg, torso rotates another30 degrees PAST the first cut toward FRONT THREE-QUARTER, belt buckle has moved around, rear foot STEPS THROUGH. First hand passes across lead thigh, blade slopes down-right after cutting. Opposite hand draws second sword behind LEFT side at hip height ready for ascending return. Shoulders lag/catch up with pelvis; cape and cloth stream left. Long full-size limbs, no kneeling.
BOTTOM RIGHT, SECOND CONTACT: drive UP through the planted front foot and rotate pelvis/torso the OTHER WAY into the ascending return cut from low-left to high-right. Torso now SIDE/BACK THREE-QUARTER, shoulder armor and rear straps readable. Rear heel pivots, front leg begins to straighten, head remains level at 85-95% of relaxed standing height. Opposite sword cuts up-right at shoulder height, first sword stays low behind. The transfer of weight and changed hip/ribcage angles must be obvious; do not repeat the same chest-forward face-on pose.
All four figures same anatomical scale, generous 10% outer margins AND gutters. Both sword tips, cape, boots fully inside each isolated cell, never overlap. No ground, scene, cast shadow, aura, speed lines, slash trails, blur, text, labels, grids or colored rim. Real transparent background. Clear full-body key animation art, weighted athletic dance, restrained face, sharp neutral clean alpha edges.

Use case: identity-preserve. FOUR whole-body key drawings in a 2x2 transparent sprite sheet, continuation of Utsu's WEIGHTED acrobatic dual-sword attack.
Image1 approved idle is AUTHORITATIVE identity, adult anatomy/limb length and weapon length. Image2 corrected first/second-hit sheet is reference for forceful pelvic turns and footwork. Keep the exact lean adult male, same small adult head relative to long torso/thighs/shins, same navy tattered cape, ivory split tunic, dark trousers, brown straps, brass star brooch and asymmetric silver armor. Same two physical straight steel swords with brass guards, one sword firmly gripped in each of exactly two hands. No extra limbs. Same fine anime painted shading as references.
Important: torso/head orientation CHANGES during the turn; no four repeating chest-front bodies with only hands moved. Body must look as large and adult as idle; mentally unfolded body7heads. Long thighs and shins remain long even when bent. Do not shrink the pelvis/chest or enlarge the head. Fixed camera, target SCREEN RIGHT, fullbody all poses.
TOP LEFT THIRD WINDUP / STEP-THROUGH: continue image2 bottomright ascending return by rotating behind the planted RIGHT/front foot. BACK THREE-QUARTER view with face looking right over shoulder. Rear/left foot is stepping across and planting under rotating pelvis, both feet near ground, knees only moderately bent. Hips visibly turn ahead of ribcage, shoulders coil last. Active sword carried around at WAIST height toward LEFT, opposing sword higher over rear shoulder pointing up-left. Athletic tall adult silhouette, braced support leg and fully visible long trailing leg.
TOP RIGHT THIRD CONTACT / TORQUE RELEASE: pelvis and ribcage have unwound into FRONT THREE-QUARTER view, same long legs. Strongly planted lead foot supports full body weight, heel/pivot turns, rear leg extends diagonally back as counterweight. Active elbow stays slightly bent as whole shoulder travels across, sword sweeps to SCREEN RIGHT horizontally chest height. Opposite sword reaches low-left behind trailing hip. Belt/hips rotate more than60degrees from previous cel and torso leans into cut15degrees. A committed whole-body rotational CUT, not a hand thrust or kicking dance.
BOTTOM LEFT FOURTH TAKEOFF / RECOIL LOAD: carry third cut's angular momentum into a visible spring: supporting boot ball pushes hard DOWN against ground, long supporting leg almost extends, opposite knee drives upward. Pelvis rotates upward before shoulders. Show a BACK/SIDE view with both sword grips close to shoulders, one blade above/behind head pointing left, one across near right hip pointing right. Hips/chest not front-on. Cape and coat lag left/down behind mass accelerating up-right. Not a miniature crouch. Clear elongated upper body and unshortened lower leg.
BOTTOM RIGHT FOURTH CONTACT / AIRBORNE BODY-DRIVEN SCISSOR: both boots offground, body travels RIGHT. Three-quarter front SIDE view, pelvis forcefully turns over leading hip while shoulders follow. Long lead leg bent at knee, trailing leg extends down-left as counterweight. Torso leans diagonally forward, head aligned with spine, hips visibly behind shoulder. Active sword sweeps diagonally from high-left to low-right across opponent chest, hand driven by turning shoulder with bent elbow, blade fully extended toward down-right. Opposite sword stays behind left shoulder, blade points left. Entire body is an athletic airborne twist, preparing forward somersault after contact.
Both COMPLETE swords, boots, cape and head in every cell. At least8% clear outer margins and generous transparent gutters, no touching/overlap, no sword tips on image border. Consistent full-size adult body dimensions in all four, do not fit bent legs by changing body size. True transparent alpha, no floor/shadow, no text/labels/grids, no scene, slash streak, glow, sparks, blur or colored edge.

Use case: identity-preserve. FOUR full-body key drawings of Utsu's weighted dual-sword landing sequence, 2x2 sprite sheet with real transparent alpha.
Image1 approved battle idle is authoritative character identity, actual adult BODY SIZE and long limb proportions, head size and sword lengths. Image2 corrected ground sheet gives same rendering, whole-body pelvic rotation and footwork. Maintain same slim adult male, long adult chest/thighs/shins, head small relative to body (7head unfolded height), focused gray eyes, tousled brown hair; navy torn cape, ivory split tunic, dark pants/shirt, brown crossing straps/belt, brass star brooch, asymmetric silver shoulder/forearm/knee/boot armor. Exactly two rigid straight steel swords with brass guards, one firmly gripped in each of exactly two hands. Every sword complete. Fixed side game camera, opponent SCREEN RIGHT.
Need physical center-of-mass and grounded weight: hips carry torso; knees and planted boots absorb the landing. Do not use same upright torso with hand-only sword poses.
TOP LEFT FIFTH WINDUP / FORWARD TUCK: airborne forward somersault AFTER aerial scissor twist. Adult body inverted diagonally with head lower-right of hips and long bent thighs drawn toward chest, boot soles above-left. Hips rotate over shoulders, back rounded, neck connected. Both swords safely outside body on opposite sides, one points far upperLEFT, other points right/down, each sword complete visible, no crossed cutting through legs. Adult head and torso size same as reference, folded legs not shrunk.
TOP RIGHT FIFTH CONTACT / WEIGHTED DESCENDING CUT: unfold downward-right from tuck into a LONG diagonal body line. Lead/front boot at RIGHT has just PLANTED under the front knee, rear leg long and extended diagonally back-left. Pelvis drives forward and DOWN over lead thigh, ribcage/shoulder turns after pelvis and leans down-right, head follows spine. Lead hand cutting a sword from upper-left to lower-right through target torso, sword tip fully visible down-right beyond front boot. Other sword counters behind left hip toward upper-left. Body-weight descending CUT with a braced planted front boot and flexed front knee, not an arm extended while standing upright or crouching into a tiny ball.
BOTTOM LEFT LANDING FOLLOW-THROUGH: same planted front boot at RIGHT and same anatomically long legs as previous. The blade has passed the contact and finishes a little further down-right. Pelvis sinks only enough to absorb landing; front knee over ankle, rear foot steps in to catch weight. Chest leans into the landing with belt visibly tilted/turned, back muscles/pelvis supporting it. Both sword grips low and away from body. NO deep sitting squat: head should remain at70-80% of relaxed stand height, bodily size unchanged. Cloth and cape continue forward slightly from inertia. Face looking at right target.
BOTTOM RIGHT RECOVERY / FULL-SIZE GUARD: push UP through the planted legs and re-center pelvis between feet. Stand at90-95% of approved idle head height with the same long legs/chest and head size, moderate fighting knee bend. Chest side-front three-quarter aimed right, no smile. One sword angled up-right beside front shoulder as approved idle, the other down-left at rear hip. Torso untwists into guard, shoulders relaxed after deceleration. This is a brief recovery naturally connecting to image1 full-size idle, not a smaller new character.
ALL FOUR whole bodies and BOTH entire swords completely within their own cells with LARGE outer margins and gutters. Make tucked pose smaller in occupied HEIGHT but maintain actual head/torso/limb size. No cuts, no neighboring overlap. Painted anime clean linework as reference, true transparent alpha, neutral edges. No scene, floor, shadow, glow, aura, slash effects, motion blur, text, labels, grids or colored fringe.
